name: Short Cut Sweet & Sour Pork Vegetable Stir-Fry with Crispy Wonton Strips

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add pork and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove to a plate, reserving the skillet (with cooking juices) for the next step.
instructions.secondary_message:
neutral vegetable oil
227 g lean ground pork

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and stir-fry until warmed through and tender, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
neutral vegetable oil
1 (454 g) pkg frozen stir-fry vegetables

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are tender, return cooked pork to the skillet and add sauce. Stir to combine and continue to cook until heated through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (312 g) pkg sweet & sour cooking sauce

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pork stir-fry and sauce between plates or bowls. Top with wonton strips and enjoy!
